note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large card issuers (no central bank ranking was read): Bank Audi, BLOM Bank and Byblos Bank. Bank Audi's card page answered 403 and BLOM Bank's a Cloudflare block on 2026-10-30, and neither was read. Byblos Bank's fees and commissions brochure (last updated 25 June 2026), its credit card fees, commissions and features, read in full on 2026-10-30 (first read 2026-10-29 for the Visa Fresh Platinum alone): its three personal credit cards are written. The Visa Platinum in Lebanese pounds costs 2,500,000 a year and 40,000 a month in maintenance, bears 2.25% a month on purchases, asks a minimum of 5% (its settlement options are 5%, 10% or 100%) and at least 500,000, and charges 100,000 for exceeding its limit; its late fee, stated in dollars, isn't written on it. The Visa Fresh Platinum in 'fresh' US dollars costs 100 dollars a year and 3 a month (the Group Offering, for holders through an employer's group, 50 and 2, a condition the game doesn't check), bears 1.75% a month on purchases and 2.083% on cash from an ATM, charges 1.5% (at least 3 dollars) for cash from an ATM in Lebanon (5%, at least 10, abroad, not written), asks a minimum of 5% and at least 35 dollars, and charges 10 dollars for exceeding the limit and 10 for a late payment. A transaction in another currency carries the foreign exchange mark-up of 4.5% and the cross-border fee of 3%, written together as 7.5% (the cross-border fee's floor of 0.75 dollars isn't modelled). The brochure states no grace period.
